title: What can Seattle learn from Dutch street design?
summary: Seattle landscape architect Fred Young gives an hour-long visual tour of Dutch cycling infrastructure, covering design details, continuous networks and how cycling fits daily life in the Netherlands.
why: HN recommends it as an in-depth tech talk for urban planning, full of small design touches that make cycling safer.

quote.text: It's a great in depth look for anyone interested in this stuff, basically a tech talk for urban planning.
